New LevelDoor format, phys_set_custom_level_box_y, story_doors.h (dlopen/dlsym/tick). Real end-to-end verification: an always-closed control script proved genuine collision blocking, a hysteresis script proved real pass-through once opened. Named gaps: no NOCK UI/IDUNA storage yet, no wire-protocol door state, no client visual. Commit SHANKPIT 4fe7ea0.
